status: short lifecycle mechanism gates passed; original UDP6 runtime capture remains incomplete
observations: Independent hash-bound execution of the original finish/command/wait/stop methods with deterministic clocks and owned-process doubles reproduced the defect: a sticky host read error prevented authorization acknowledgment acceptance and suppressed finalize, producing simulated 119/299-second waits for 120/300-second cleanup cutoffs. This is a source counterexample, not a recovered runtime03 stack or measured blocking interval.

The two-file correction separately tracks authorization transmission, sends ordered cleanup finalization only after observed producer exit, and bounds failed-path drain grace to at most two seconds within the original absolute cutoff. Sent is not acknowledged. Original errors remain sticky; normal drain allowance, general wait and complete-capture predicate are unchanged.

The hosted Linux gate ran 108 required tests with zero skips, including deterministic lost/unsent acknowledgment, unknown exit, failed finalize, new drain error, expired/short deadline, close uncertainty and unchanged healthy drain cases. A real owned Python producer/drain-child fixture also verifies failed-capture finalization without promoting capture completeness. Separate local workflow-equivalent UDP6 regression ran 710 tests with zero skips.

Actual paused QEMU 8.2.2 FIFO and owned-worker gates passed normal, forced-stop, dump-write-error and overflow mechanisms. No guest executed. Normal capture completes; forced/error/overflow cases remain incomplete. The overflow fixture retained 64 of 102 drained bytes, observed child exit 4 without forced child termination, and preserved overflow failure. This synthetic 64-byte cap is not the production 64 MiB run measurement.

All reported process exits, descriptors, QMP/network sockets and owned work/root cleanup completed in the actual mechanism gates. No raw PCAP or logs were uploaded. The path-triggered direct runtime workflow had compile/native jobs skipped; no Windows VM or production network CLI ran.
limits: This corrects a reproducible failure-finalization delay, not the capture overflow source or opaque/truncated decoder causes. Runtime03 remains immutable and inconclusive; no packet absence is restored retrospectively.
The actual QEMU fixture injects ingress frames to exercise capture lifecycle; it is not ordinary guest IPv6 egress calibration, isolation, DNS/proxy or product acceptance.
No capture limit, packet acceptance, identity/policy, networking configuration or original work deadline was increased or relaxed. No automatic guest retry occurred.
